name: AgiBot GO-2
summary: GO-2 is AgiBot's second-generation ViLLA (vision-language-latent-action) foundation model, announced at the company's 2026 Partner Conference. Its central mechanism is Action Chain-of-Thought: the model reasons in an intermediate action-level representation that bridges high-level planning and low-level execution, so a long-horizon task stays consistent between what was planned and what the actuators do. AgiBot reports state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks and positions GO-2 as the model for large-scale real-world deployment, backed by the AgiBot World dataset and one of the largest humanoid production runs in China.
innovation: Action-level chain-of-thought as the interface between planner and controller, rather than language subgoals.
Trained against one of the largest open real-robot corpora, its own AgiBot World.
matters: The clearest Chinese counterpart to the GR00T and pi-0 lines, and it ships onto hardware the company builds at volume.
limits: Announced at a partner conference; benchmark claims are unspecified as to which benchmarks and against what.
Unlike AgiBot World, the GO-2 weights are not open.
lineage: GO-1's ViLLA formulation plus embodied chain-of-thought reasoning, trained on AgiBot World.
